Hauling the runaway clay-cake off the tilting bakery shelf before it topples onto the clay-market below — the clay-baker shoves both palms against the wobbling tier, the clay-grandma wraps her apron around the base pulling backward, the clay-shopkeeper braces a clay-broom under the lowest layer, the clay-postman skids through the doorway scattering clay-envelopes as the frosting slowly peels and drapes like a melting curtain across the countertop

Chasing the escaped clay-pig down the cobblestone hill as it barrels through a clay-flower-cart — the clay-baker sprints with arms windmilling, the clay-villager dives and misses landing face-first in clay-mud, the clay-grandma leans from her window swinging a clay-ladle, the clay-postman pedals furiously on his clay-bicycle weaving between bouncing clay-turnips the pig scatters in its wake

Toppling the enormous clay-cauldron as it boils over with luminous green clay-sludge across the workshop floor — the clay-tinkerer yanks the clay-lever but it snaps off in his hand, the clay-witch shoves a clay-barrel under the spout to catch the overflow, the clay-apprentice slides backward through the spreading sludge grabbing at the workbench leg, a clay-cat leaps from shelf to shelf as the floor becomes a slow green swamp

Dragging the enormous discovered clay-map out from beneath three collapsed shelves of clay-archive-jars while the ceiling cracks overhead — the clay-detective pulls one rolled edge, the clay-tinkerer heaves another corner, the clay-rabbit pushes from underneath with both hind feet, a clay-villager wedges a clay-crowbar under the heaviest shelf and strains with bent knees as plaster-coloured clay-dust rains down on all of them

Stuffing the misfired clay-invention's spinning clay-gears with handfuls of clay-putty before the whole contraption shakes itself apart — the clay-tinkerer hammers wedges into the axle housing, the clay-baker sits on the vibrating lid pressing it down with full body weight, the clay-rabbit bites through a tangled clay-wire, the clay-detective photographs the chaos from the doorway while the workshop walls visibly bow outward with each mechanical shudder

Sliding the arriving clay-stranger's enormous clay-trunk up the narrow staircase while it keeps reversing and crushing everyone below — the clay-postman shoves from the bottom step red-faced, the clay-grandma pulls a rope looped around the trunk handle from the top landing, the clay-shopkeeper wedges her shoulder under one corner, the clay-stranger stands at the door tapping a clay-umbrella impatiently as plaster chips shower down the stairwell

Rolling the giant runaway clay-cheese-wheel through the village square as it smashes through clay-market stalls — the clay-baker sprints ahead trying to redirect it with a plank, the clay-shopkeeper dives behind a clay-barrel, the clay-grandma climbs on top of it attempting to ride it to a stop, the clay-postman blows his clay-whistle furiously while the wheel collects clay-cabbages and a clay-hat-rack and keeps accelerating downhill

Discovering a sealed clay-trapdoor under the bakery floor as it begins glowing faintly orange from beneath — the clay-baker kneels pressing an ear to the warm clay surface, the clay-detective scrapes away dried clay-dough revealing carved symbols, the clay-grandma backs against the oven clutching her clay-rolling-pin with both hands, the clay-rabbit sniffs along the edge and suddenly drops into a crouch as the orange glow pulses brighter and the bread on the shelves begins to rise on its own

Repairing the crumbling clay-bridge as the clay-river below rises and chews at its supports — the clay-tinkerer bolts clay-brackets to the underside hanging from a rope, the clay-villager passes clay-planks from a wheelbarrow, the clay-postman cycles across the wobbling surface delivering a package because his schedule demands it, the clay-detective holds a clay-lantern over the edge measuring how fast the river climbs, the clay-sheep bleats from the far bank refusing to cross

Smashing through the clay-wall of the abandoned clay-tower after the clay-detective discovers the hidden room seals from inside — the clay-tinkerer swings a clay-mallet at the mortar, the clay-rabbit tunnels from below sending up sprays of clay-soil, the clay-detective presses a clay-stethoscope to the wall listening for movement, the clay-witch watches from the tree-line her painted clay-eyes reflecting the lantern-light, the clay-grandma passes replacement clay-bricks in a bucket in case they need to reseal it quickly

Mixing the wrong clay-potions together as they foam and creep across the clay-witch's worktable threatening everything on the shelf — the clay-witch clamps both hands over the bubbling clay-beaker, the clay-apprentice tips a bucket of clay-sand onto the spreading foam, the clay-tinkerer wraps copper clay-tubing around the base trying to redirect the overflow, a clay-rat gnaws through a shelf leg at the worst possible moment sending a row of clay-bottles sliding toward the edge

Lifting the collapsed clay-oven door off the clay-baker who is trapped underneath shouting instructions upward — the clay-grandma and clay-postman heave from opposite sides, the clay-shopkeeper wedges a clay-rolling-pin under the hinge as a fulcrum, the clay-tinkerer works a clay-jack under the far corner cranking frantically, the clay-baker's clay-hand reaches through the gap holding a tray of perfectly-intact clay-scones that nobody can explain

Stealing the glowing clay-gem back from the clay-witch's mantelpiece while she stirs something enormous in the next room — the clay-detective reaches for it with clay-tongs, the clay-rabbit holds the floorboards steady to stop them creaking, the clay-tinkerer cuts the alarm-wire with tiny clay-scissors, the clay-apprentice watches the doorway counting the seconds between the witch's stirs, the clay-cat on the mantelpiece opens one painted eye and begins to purr loudly threatening to expose them all

Wrestling the enormous clay-squid that has wrapped its clay-tentacles around the village water-tower and begun to pull — the clay-villager hacks at one tentacle with a clay-axe, the clay-tinkerer fires a clay-harpoon that bounces harmlessly off the rubbery surface, the clay-detective lashes a rope around a tentacle and ties the other end to a clay-horse who strains forward hooves churning, the clay-baker throws boiling clay-broth from the bakery window which makes the squid angrier

Building the emergency clay-dam across the flooded village lane while the clay-river pours in from the eastern field — the clay-villager stacks clay-sandbags in an overlapping wall, the clay-tinkerer operates a small clay-pump that keeps clogging with clay-debris, the clay-postman wades through knee-deep clay-water still clutching his delivery bag, the clay-grandma directs traffic from her front step using a clay-megaphone she made that morning, the clay-sheep simply floats past looking serene

Sneaking the enormous clay-birthday-cake through the village square at midnight so the clay-grandma won't wake and see it before morning — the clay-baker balances it on a clay-cart that keeps squeaking, the clay-postman oils the cart-wheels with a clay-oil-can that drips loudly on the cobblestones, the clay-tinkerer holds a clay-lantern shielded with a clay-shutter, the clay-rabbit scouts ahead and signals clear with its ears, then signals not-clear as the grandma's bedroom light flickers on above them

Discovering the ancient clay-egg buried under the workshop floor as it begins to crack open from the inside — the clay-tinkerer holds the egg in both hands backing away slowly, the clay-detective circles it with a clay-measuring-tape documenting the fracture lines, the clay-grandma pushes everyone behind her as she raises the clay-rolling-pin, the clay-rabbit presses its nose to the crack then jerks back as something warm and glowing presses outward against the shell from within

Hauling the misfired clay-rocket back out of the village pond before the mayor arrives for the morning inspection — the clay-tinkerer and clay-postman pull a rope tied to the rocket's tail-fin, the clay-detective wades in pushing from below with a clay-pole, the clay-baker stands on the bank squeezing water from his apron and pretending none of this is his fault, the clay-rabbit has already begun sculpting a new decorative hedge to replace the one the rocket shredded on its way through

Sculpting a replacement clay-face for the clay-shop-sign before the clay-shopkeeper returns from the clay-market and notices it was knocked off by the runaway clay-cart — the clay-tinkerer smooths the jaw with a thumb-tool, the clay-baker paints the enamel eyes with a tiny clay-brush, the clay-grandma holds the sign steady on her knees, the clay-postman spots the shopkeeper's clay-hat appearing over the hill and begins making increasingly frantic hand gestures at the others who refuse to rush

Toppling the cursed clay-statue in the village square before midnight as it slowly turns its clay-head toward the baker's window — the clay-detective loops a chain around its neck and pulls, the clay-tinkerer drills into its clay-pedestal with a clay-auger, the clay-villager pushes from behind grunting with full weight, the clay-grandma places a clay-candle circle around the base reading from a clay-booklet, the clay-rabbit watches the statue's painted eyes track the baker's lit window and bolts

Repairing the clay-postman's crashed clay-bicycle while three urgent parcels bleed their clay-dye onto the cobblestones — the clay-tinkerer bends the buckled clay-frame back over his knee, the clay-baker re-inflates the clay-tyre by blowing into a clay-valve, the clay-shopkeeper gathers the leaking parcels stacking them on her awning, the clay-grandma ties the handlebars straight with her clay-headscarf, the clay-postman reads his delivery manifest and announces he is already eleven minutes behind schedule

Chasing the clay-witch's escaped clay-familiar through the tinkerer's workshop as it knocks clay-inventions off every shelf — the clay-tinkerer dives over the workbench arms outstretched, the clay-detective herds it toward the corner with a clay-filing-cabinet drawer, the clay-rabbit blocks the gap under the door with its body, the clay-baker who came to collect his clay-wrench stands in the doorway holding his tray and getting progressively covered in falling clay-components as the familiar scurries through his legs

Sliding the enormous arriving clay-stranger's clay-caravan into position in the village square before the evening fair opens — the clay-villager cranks a clay-winch at the front, the clay-postman guides from behind calling out clearances, the clay-tinkerer greases the clay-wheel bearings mid-roll without stopping, the clay-baker lays clay-planks across the muddy patch, the clay-sheep stand in a line and refuse to move from exactly where the caravan needs to park and no amount of shooing changes this

Discovering that the clay-map leads directly under the clay-grandma's cottage as her kitchen floor begins to glow from below — the clay-detective traces the route with a clay-compass across the map spread on the clay-table, the clay-tinkerer hammers on the kitchen flagstones listening for hollow clay underneath, the clay-grandma peers into the glowing crack in the floor saying she always wondered about that, the clay-rabbit drops a clay-pebble into the crack and everyone waits a very long time for it to land

Wrestling the enormous clay-wedding-cake back upright on the clay-cart as it tilts toward the cobblestones with one second before the clay-mayor arrives at the reception — the clay-baker braces the base with both forearms, the clay-grandma pushes the top tier straight with a clay-spatula, the clay-tinkerer bolts an emergency clay-bracket to the cart-side drilling at frantic speed, the clay-postman throws his delivery bag as a counterweight wedging it under the downhill wheel as the mayor's clay-carriage rounds the corner

Hauling a runaway clay-wedding-cake down the cobblestone hill before it crushes the market — the clay-baker sprints alongside grabbing for the toppling tiers, the clay-postman dives flat and slides on his belly trying to wedge himself underneath, the clay-grandma flings her clay-shawl like a lasso, the clay-shopkeeper yanks her awning down as a net, the cake detonates against the fountain in a spectacular frosted clay eruption soaking everyone in white fondant chunks

Chasing a misfired clay-rocket invention that zigzags through the village bakery window and out the chimney — the clay-tinkerer sprints waving a clay-wrench screaming corrections, the clay-baker ducks as it vaporises his prize clay-loaves, the clay-postman's bicycle gets clipped and spins him into a hedge, the clay-grandma on her balcony pelts it with clay-flower-pots, the rocket finally corkscrews into the village pond sending a geyser of grey clay-water thirty feet skyward

Discovering a buried clay-treasure-chest beneath the village square as the whole cobblestone surface buckles and lifts — the clay-detective pries the lid with a clay-crowbar his eyes bulging, the clay-villager scrambles backward as flagstones pop loose around her feet, a clay-rabbit erupts from its burrow tumbling across the displaced earth, the clay-shopkeeper grabs her display shelves before everything slides, and the chest springs open releasing a cascade of glowing clay-coins that roll into every gutter and doorway

Toppling an enormous clay-beeswax-candle in the town hall during the midnight ceremony as the flame licks the paper-clay banners — the clay-grandma slaps at the rolling candle with her clay-hymn-book, the clay-postman throws his entire mail-sack over the flame, the clay-tinkerer slides across the waxed floor grabbing the candle and scalding his clay-fingers, the clay-villager screams and tugs the banner free before it catches, wax pooling in warm amber rivers across the ceremonial clay-floor tiles

Dragging an arriving clay-stranger's enormous clay-trunk up the narrow staircase of the clay-inn while it keeps bursting open — the clay-tinkerer pushes from below, the clay-baker pulls from the landing above, the trunk lid flaps releasing a torrent of peculiar clay-objects that bounce down the stairs, the clay-grandma tries to catch them and gets bowled over, the clay-stranger herself stands at the bottom shouting instructions nobody can hear over the cascading mechanical clattering

Sculpting a replacement clay-nose for the village statue at dawn before the mayor arrives for the unveiling — the clay-tinkerer works frantically smoothing the clay-bridge, the clay-baker holds the ladder which wobbles on the uneven square, the clay-rabbit chews through the tarpaulin rope at exactly the wrong moment, the clay-grandma catches the tarpaulin but drags the ladder sideways, the tinkerer lunges and slaps the nose on slightly crooked just as the clay-mayor's clay-car rattles around the corner

Stuffing an escaped clay-sheep back through the clay-bakery window before the morning rush spots it — the clay-baker pushes from outside both arms vanishing elbow-deep in wool, the clay-postman leans in to help and gets his hat eaten, the clay-grandma pulls from inside with a rope tied to the sheep's middle section, the sheep expands from pressure and pops free sending the baker tumbling into his own flour-barrel erupting in a white clay-cloud visible from three streets away

Repairing the cracked clay-village-clock as its gears spill across the cobblestones and it begins striking the wrong hour — the clay-tinkerer catches sprockets in his apron-pockets, the clay-detective deduces which gear goes where from scorch marks on the mechanism, the clay-shopkeeper dashes outside to tell customers the time is wrong, the clay-postman has already delivered everything to the wrong address and runs back red-faced, the clock strikes seventeen and every clay-bird in the square launches from the fountain simultaneously

Rolling a monstrous clay-cheese-wheel through the narrow market-gate as it gathers speed and the gate proves six inches too small — the clay-shopkeeper shoves from behind, the clay-baker braces in front and immediately regrets it, the clay-grandma greases the gateposts with clay-butter from her shopping basket, the clay-postman runs alongside shouting measurements with a clay-tape, the cheese compresses into an oval forcing through with a thunderclap pop that sends stall-banners flapping all down the market row

Smashing through the locked clay-cellar-door to reach the rising clay-flood from a burst clay-pipe below the village — the clay-tinkerer swings a clay-sledgehammer, the clay-detective kicks alongside him, the clay-baker passes sandbags of flour-sacks, the clay-grandma runs the pump-handle outside as orange clay-water seeps under the door, the door buckles inward and a wall of warm terracotta slurry surges into the street carrying boots and clay-bottles bobbing past the speechless clay-postman on his bicycle

Stealing back the clay-detective's evidence-board from inside the locked clay-witch's tower before sunrise — the clay-rabbit shimmies up the drainpipe with a clay-grappling-hook, the clay-detective whispers frantic instructions from below, the clay-tinkerer boosts the clay-villager onto the wall to act as lookout, a clay-raven inside the tower begins squawking an alarm, the board comes sailing out the window wrapped in a clay-curtain and lands directly on the detective's head flattening his hat to a disc

Mixing a glowing clay-potion that rapidly expands and begins filling the clay-witch's workshop faster than anyone expected — the clay-witch herself stirs faster trying to control it, the clay-apprentice shoves clay-stoppers into cracked bottles, the clay-tinkerer reverses his clay-pump bellowing steam to vent pressure, a clay-cat levitates on the rising foam batting at bubbles, the mixture reaches the ceiling and blows the skylight open raining luminous droplets across the night village rooftops in arcs of spectral amber

Lifting the clay-grandma's prize clay-sunflower which has grown overnight to the height of the church steeple and is bending toward the road — the clay-baker and clay-postman heave guy-ropes tied around the stalk, the clay-tinkerer rigs a clay-pulley to the bakery chimney, the clay-grandma herself climbs a ladder to water the top and makes things considerably worse, the stalk bends further cracking the garden wall as enormous clay-petals rain down on the entire street below

Sliding down the icy clay-hillside on an out-of-control clay-delivery-sled packed with the entire village's post — the clay-postman steers desperately with one boot, parcels launch off the back one by one, the clay-baker waiting at the bottom dives left, the clay-sheep scatter in four directions, the clay-grandma sticks her walking-stick out and catches the sled's runner spinning the whole contraption one-eighty, the sled stops perfectly outside the post-office and a single letter floats gently onto the doormat

Wrestling the clay-tinkerer's invention away from the clay-witch as it sparks and tries to walk out of the workshop under its own power — the clay-detective grabs one clay-leg of the contraption, the clay-tinkerer grabs the other, the clay-witch clutches the middle section with both hands, the invention fires a clay-gear that ricochets off three walls, the clay-rabbit bites through a cable and the machine sits down heavily on the workshop floor emitting a single dignified puff of green smoke

Building an emergency clay-dam across the bakery doorway as the clay-river floods Main Street three days before the clay-harvest-festival — the clay-baker mortars clay-bricks with fistfuls of dough, the clay-tinkerer drives wooden stakes with a mallet, the clay-shopkeeper passes buckets from above through her first-floor window, the clay-grandma knits sandbag-covers at terrifying speed, the clay-postman arrives with the morning deliveries and becomes the last brick by sheer necessity jammed cheerfully into the remaining gap

Sneaking the enormous clay-birthday-cake past the sleeping clay-grandma's room at midnight without the floor creaking — the clay-baker leads with the cake balanced on his head arms outstretched, the clay-postman tiptoes behind with his boots in his hands, the clay-tinkerer oils each floorboard just ahead of the procession with a clay-oilcan, the cake tilts, a candle rolls free and clinks against the banister, the grandma stirs, everyone freezes, then she mumbles and resumes snoring as they inch forward sweating

Chasing a discovered clay-map that the wind keeps snatching away through the labyrinthine hedgerows of the old clay-estate at dusk — the clay-detective lunges and misses, the clay-rabbit darts ahead cutting corners through gaps in the hedge, the clay-villager climbs a clay-tree to track it from above, the clay-tinkerer fans it downward with his coat, the map finally pastes itself against the locked gate of a long-abandoned greenhouse revealing by lamplight a second smaller map scratched onto the iron bars themselves

Toppling a towering clay-library bookshelf during the hunt for the forbidden clay-grimoire the clay-witch reported stolen — the clay-detective clings to the falling shelf as books avalanche, the clay-villager scrambles beneath to catch the grimoire before it vanishes into the pile, the clay-tinkerer props the next shelf with a clay-pole so the collapse stops at one, the clay-grandma sits calmly on top of the rubble still knitting having ridden it down, the grimoire slides to a stop at the clay-rabbit's feet glowing faintly

Dragging a clay-sea-monster's tail back through the harbour gate before the clay-tide carries it into the village — the clay-detective, clay-baker, and clay-tinkerer heave a rope together boots scraping the wet clay-cobbles, the clay-postman winds the slack round the harbourmaster's bollard, the clay-grandma drives a clay-cart horse that pulls the other end, the monster emits a mournful foghorn bellow, its tail scrapes back through the iron gate with a clang and the sea-lock slams shut shaking the entire clay-quayside

Sculpting a decoy clay-figure at desperate speed to trick the arriving clay-witch who wants her cursed clay-locket returned — the clay-tinkerer slaps clay onto an armature while the detective dictates proportions, the clay-baker paints a face on with cake-icing brush, the clay-rabbit poses as a model, the real locket gets stuffed inside the decoy's chest, the clay-witch's shadow darkens the workshop-window glass, the tinkerer jams the last detail on a second before the door opens and everyone adopts expressions of total innocent incompetence

Repairing the clay-bridge over the ravine as six clay-villagers are already crossing it and more arrive from the other side — the clay-tinkerer hammers bolts from below hanging from a clay-rope, the clay-detective directs traffic with two clay-flags, the clay-baker sits on a cracked central plank as a counterweight clutching his hat, the clay-grandma reverses her clay-cart single-handedly off the far end, the clay-postman cycles across at full speed because he simply cannot be late and makes it just as the last loose stone drops into the ravine below

Discovering the clay-baker's secret underground oven that has been baking by itself for thirty years as warm clay-loaves roll up a conveyor into the darkened shop at midnight — the clay-detective dusts for fingerprints on loaves that have no fingerprints, the clay-tinkerer crawls through the trapdoor with a lamp, the clay-villager stacks the loaves filling the entire shop counter, the clay-grandma bites one and declares it perfect, the clay-baker himself arrives last and stares at the machine with the total convincing bewilderment of someone who absolutely built it

Wrestling a clay-hot-air-balloon down from the village church steeple where it snagged during the clay-inventor's festival launch — the clay-tinkerer dangles from the basket trying to free the rigging, the clay-detective anchors the rope to the church fence with both boots dug in, the clay-baker and clay-postman pull a second rope hand-over-hand their feet leaving long skid marks in the clay-grass, the clay-grandma clips the snagged cable with garden shears from the bell-tower window, the balloon surges free and carries the tinkerer three feet up before the rope goes taut

Smashing open the clay-ice-vault beneath the old clay-manor to recover the frozen clay-evidence before the clay-witch destroys it — the clay-detective swings a clay-pickaxe and sparks fly, the clay-tinkerer aims a steam-nozzle at the ice-wall and it screams and splits, the clay-rabbit digs with both forepaws sending ice-chips flying, the clay-villager catches each emerging clay-artifact in a padded box, the final block shatters and the evidence inside tumbles free intact: a single perfectly-preserved clay-key still warm to the touch despite the ice surrounding it

Hauling a runaway clay-barrel of clay-honey down the cobblestone hill as it gathers speed — the clay-baker sprints ahead waving his arms to clear the path, the clay-shopkeeper dives behind her awning as the barrel clips her display of clay-jars, the clay-grandma plants her walking stick trying to trip the barrel and gets dragged three cobblestones, the clay-postman abandons his clay-mailbag and flings himself onto the barrel's side riding it toward the fountain

Toppling a seven-tiered clay wedding-cake in slow catastrophic stages as each layer slides — the clay-baker lunges to catch the top tier and misses by a fingerwidth, the clay-shopkeeper shoves a clay-table under the falling second layer splintering it, the clay-grandma cups both hands under the collapsing third tier and takes the full sugary weight to her chin, the clay-rabbit bolts between everyone's legs accelerating the collapse, frosting splatters every surface of the clay-kitchen

Chasing the escaped clay-pig across the cobblestone market square as it scatters stalls of clay-turnips — the clay-baker drops his bread tray and dives, the clay-shopkeeper leaps her counter gripping a broom, the clay-grandma swings her rolling-pin wide trying to corral the pig toward the well, the clay-postman pedals his bicycle directly into the haystack as the pig veers left spraying clay-feathers across the plaza

Smashing through the clay-bakery wall as a misfired clay-cannon prototype punches a perfect circle of debris outward — the clay-tinkerer scrambles after the ricocheting cannonball trailing a rope, the clay-baker shrieks and presses his back flat against the opposite wall, the clay-shopkeeper appears in the new hole squinting through the dust with arms crossed, the clay-rabbit bolts under the counter trailing flour footprints across the checkered clay floor

Repairing the crumbling clay-bridge over the village creek before the annual clay-cart parade arrives — the clay-tinkerer slaps wet clay into the widening crack with both palms, the clay-villager stomps the patch flat with enormous boots, the clay-grandma lowers a bucket of fresh clay on a rope from the bank above, the clay-postman crosses anyway balancing his mail-sack on his head as planks dip dangerously beneath each step

Discovering a sealed clay-trapdoor beneath the bakery floor that pulses with faint orange light — the clay-baker jabs it with a rolling pin and stumbles backward, the clay-detective kneels pressing a magnifying glass against the clay-latch examining tiny fingerprints, the clay-rabbit sniffs the edge and skitters away fur spiked, the clay-grandma produces an enormous key from her apron pocket that perfectly matches the lock without anyone asking where she got it

Sculpting frantically as a clay-witch hammers on the workshop door demanding the cursed clay-mask back — the clay-tinkerer crams extra clay into the mask's cracked eye-socket racing the clock, his clay-apprentice braces both shoulders against the door absorbing each impact, the clay-cat arches its spine hissing from the workbench, a half-finished clay-skeleton rattles sympathetically from a shelf, the witch's distorted shadow swells across the clay-window with each thunderous knock

Rolling an enormous clay-cheese wheel out of the shop and directly into the village fountain — the clay-shopkeeper pushes from behind with both hands uselessly insufficient, the clay-baker throws his body in front of it as a brake and gets flattened, the clay-grandma ties a rope around the cheese but the rope snaps sending the clay-grandma tumbling into the begonias, two clay-sheep scatter as the wheel hits the fountain's rim and teeters on the edge

Stealing the glowing clay-compass from the clay-detective's coat pocket as he interrogates the wrong suspect in the town square — the clay-witch dips two fingers into his breast pocket and withdraws the compass, it spins wildly and emits a clay-smoke ring, the clay-detective wheels around grabbing at nothing, the clay-rabbit by the lamppost stuffs the compass into a bag and bolts, the clay-villager points in three wrong directions simultaneously

Mixing an enormous clay-cauldron of mystery dye that turns everything it splashes green — the clay-witch stirs counterclockwise with a clay-ladle, the clay-tinkerer leans over the rim for a closer look and receives a full green splash to the face, the clay-baker backs away with both arms raised but his apron hem dips into the cauldron anyway, the clay-sheep tries to lick a droplet off the floor and its wool turns spectacularly, irreversibly green

Lifting a collapsed clay-bookshelf that has pinned the clay-detective's coat to the floor during a library search for the missing clay-map — the clay-grandma heaves one end with surprising vigor, the clay-tinkerer wedges a clay-lever under the middle shelf, the clay-detective slides out of the coat and keeps reading the buried book, the clay-rabbit pulls books off the fallen shelf and flings them over its shoulder hunting for the hidden compartment

Dragging a massive clay-snowball down the wrong side of the hill toward the clay-baker's open oven door — the clay-villager clings to the snowball trying to steer it left with his whole body weight, the clay-baker spots it through his window and throws his arms wide in the doorframe, the clay-sheep runs alongside bleating and getting progressively buried in the snowball's accumulated clay-debris, the clay-grandma at the hilltop shouts instructions nobody can hear

Stuffing a misfired clay-invention back into its clay-crate before the clay-shopkeeper's customers notice it waddling among the shelves — the clay-tinkerer chases the invention around a display of clay-jars grabbing at its spinning fins, the clay-baker sits on the crate lid to hold it shut but the crate walks out from under him, the clay-shopkeeper drapes a tablecloth over the invention and pretends to customers it is a lamp, the clay-rabbit digs frantically under the invention trying to slow its legs

Sliding down the clay-village rooftop on a clay-tray of uncooked bread loaves that serve as unexpected sleds — the clay-baker screams and grabs the chimney pot which snaps off and comes along for the ride, the clay-postman on the street below shields his face with a mail-pouch, the clay-tinkerer on a ladder grabs for the baker and joins the descent, the clay-grandma on the ground below opens a large clay-umbrella instinctively as two men and a chimney-pot arrive at speed

Wrestling a tangled clay-invention that wraps its mechanical arms around the clay-tinkerer's workshop and begins to squeeze — the clay-tinkerer jams a wrench between two gears screaming for assistance, the clay-baker shoves his shoulder against one mechanical arm straining every seam of his clay-jacket, the clay-detective circles the building making notes, the clay-rabbit gnaws through a clay-cable which unfortunately makes the machine squeeze harder and emit a triumphant whistle

Building a towering clay-sandcastle on the beach as the clay-tide begins dissolving the foundation faster than the builders can pile new clay — the clay-grandma pats walls frantically from the outside, the clay-villager scoops clay at the base and slaps it higher, the clay-rabbit sprints back and forth carrying palm-sized clay-bricks from a pit inland, the clay-tinkerer installs a tiny clay-pump to drain the tide which pumps water directly back onto the castle from the other side

Sneaking a massive clay-present through the village in the dead of night as it emits suspicious ticking and occasional muffled squeaks — the clay-tinkerer shuffles beneath one end hunched low, the clay-postman holds the other end and high-steps past a sleeping clay-sheep, the clay-detective follows at a cautious distance sketching the box in his notebook, the clay-witch drifts above the scene on her broomstick aiming a clay-lantern downward illuminating the entire sneaking procession

Chasing a clay-ghost through the clay-village library as it pulls books off shelves and arranges them into an ominous message — the clay-detective throws a clay-net which passes straight through and drapes over himself, the clay-grandma whacks the ghost with a rolled clay-newspaper having reasonable success, the clay-rabbit gathers the scattered books in reverse order trying to read the message backwards, the clay-tinkerer unpacks a clay-ghost-catching device which immediately attracts the ghost to the wrong compartment

Hauling the clay-detective's enormous evidence board through a narrow clay-door as a storm floods the clay-street outside — the clay-detective tilts the board diagonally and jams it, the clay-tinkerer removes the door hinges while standing in rising clay-water, the clay-villager pushes from outside getting gradually submerged, the clay-grandma threads a rope through the window and pulls a corner adding a third contradictory force to the geometry of the stuck board

Discovering the clay-village bell has been replaced overnight with an enormous clay-egg that begins to crack — the clay-grandma pokes it with her stick and the crack spreads, the clay-detective photographs every surface of the egg before anyone can stop him, the clay-tinkerer builds a hasty clay-support structure around it as pieces fall, the clay-postman backs away with his mail-sack pulled over his head, two clay-sheep press their noses against the base sniffing the seam

Sculpting a clay-decoy of the stolen clay-map in the detective's office as the thief is expected to return and swap it — the clay-detective dabs paint on the fake map with fierce concentration, the clay-tinkerer installs a spring-loaded clay-cage directly above the table, the clay-grandma sits in the corner knitting with her back to the door performing theatrical innocence, the clay-rabbit crouches inside a clay-vase with only its ears visible serving as the lookout

Toppling the clay-market's entire tower of clay-pumpkins when the clay-sheep backs into the bottom row trying to escape a bee — the clay-shopkeeper throws both arms around the second tier too late, the clay-baker catches two pumpkins on his tray and watches a third roll off in three different directions, the clay-grandma and the clay-villager collide attempting to block the pumpkin avalanche from different angles and bounce off each other, the clay-sheep disappears entirely under an orange clay-landslide

Mixing a forbidden clay-colour by combining every paint-pot in the workshop until the resulting substance develops a slow heartbeat — the clay-witch stirs the pot with both hands singing something low, the clay-tinkerer disconnects two pipes from the cauldron's base and reconnects them in panic, the clay-baker edges toward the door but his clay-boots have adhered to the floor, the clay-rabbit vibrates at a frequency only clay-animals detect and flattens itself under the workbench

Repairing the clay-lighthouse lamp before the clay-ship visible through the clay-fog reaches the rocks — the clay-tinkerer replaces the clay-bulb while balanced on the clay-tinkerer's own invention which wobbles, the clay-detective below cranks an emergency generator with both arms and one knee, the clay-grandma feeds a replacement cable up through the tower via a pulley system she invented thirty seconds ago, the clay-witch hovers at lamp-height outside the glass offering unsolicited pointing directions

Sliding the glowing clay-artifact out of its ancient clay-pedestal in the underground chamber as the ceiling begins a very deliberate descent — the clay-detective pulls the artifact while reading warning engravings aloud to everyone's mounting horror, the clay-tinkerer jams clay-wedges into the ceiling mechanism buying inches and seconds, the clay-rabbit sprints back and forth measuring the ceiling gap against its own ears as a calibration tool, the clay-grandma walks calmly toward the exit remarking she has seen worse, which no one believes

Hauling the enormous clay-wedding-cake across the village square as it lists dangerously to the left — the clay-baker shoves from behind with both palms flat, the clay-shopkeeper grabs a wobbling sugar-flower tier before it slides, the clay-grandma jams her clay-walking-stick under the base like a lever, the clay-postman pedals his bicycle backwards trying to clear a path, and the bottom layer begins slowly accordion-squishing under the weight with a visible thumbprint crater spreading across its frosted side

Chasing the runaway clay-pig down the cobblestone hill as it steamrolls through a row of clay-flowerpots — the clay-baker dives and skids across the wet clay-road on his belly, the clay-shopkeeper flings a net made of twisted clay-string that misses entirely, two clay-villagers scramble up onto a clay-fence as the pig barrels through, the clay-grandma leans from her upstairs window dangling a clay-carrot on a fishing rod while the pig ignores it completely

Mixing an enormous vat of luminous green clay-potion as it overflows the cauldron rim and crawls across the workshop floor — the clay-witch stirs furiously adding fistfuls of clay-powder, her clay-apprentice mops with a clay-rag that instantly dissolves, a clay-rat runs along a shelf knocking down bottles, the clay-tinkerer in the doorway slaps a clay-plank across the threshold trying to dam the flow, the potion begins slowly digesting a clay-stool leg

Toppling the massive clay-bookshelf in the village library as a hidden clay-door swings open behind it — the clay-detective throws his shoulder against the shelf and shoves, clay-books cascade and flap their pages, the clay-shopkeeper catches an armload of volumes before tripping backwards onto a reading-chair, a clay-rabbit bolts from the shelf carrying a tiny clay-scroll in its teeth, and beyond the revealed door a clay-staircase spirals down into orange-lit darkness

Repairing the fractured clay-bridge over the river as the clay-water below begins rising with visible ripple-rings pressed by thumb — the clay-tinkerer slaps wet clay patches over the cracks and smooths them desperately, the clay-baker and clay-villager each hold a bridge-plank in place with their chests, a clay-sheep stands exactly in the middle refusing to move and bobbing slightly, the clay-postman on the far bank stamps his foot pointing at the rising water-level inching toward the arch

Stuffing clay-sausages into an enormous clay-sausage machine as the machine begins vibrating and walking itself across the kitchen floor — the clay-baker cranks the handle faster in a panic, clay-sausage links spray from the nozzle coiling around the room, the clay-grandma grabs a looping garland and is pulled off her feet, a clay-cat sits on the counter batting at passing sausage-links, and the machine bumps through the kitchen door and begins descending the front steps one clank at a time

Discovering a clay-treasure-chest buried under the village fountain as the fountain itself tilts sideways and begins spraying clay-water sideways — the clay-detective jabs his clay-trowel under the lid, the clay-shopkeeper and clay-villager each heave on a rope tied to the chest, a clay-rabbit circles excitedly kicking loose clay-cobblestones everywhere, the clay-postman is soaked by the tilted fountain stream and slips, and the chest lid finally pops open revealing only a second smaller chest inside

Sliding down a vast clay-mudslide carrying the entire contents of the village market stall with them — the clay-baker rides a clay-breadboard like a sled arms spinning, the clay-shopkeeper hugs her clay-cash-register to her chest as coins spray upward, two clay-villagers hold hands tumbling together sideways, the clay-rabbit overtakes everyone with its ears flat back, and at the bottom a clay-haystack waits to absorb the entire procession with a satisfying squish

Wrestling a giant clay-turnip out of the ground as it slowly pulls back like it has roots with opinions — the clay-grandma anchors a rope around it with her clay-walking-stick jammed in the soil, the clay-baker and clay-villager both lean backward hauling the rope, the clay-tinkerer has built a small clay-pulley system that is currently unwinding itself from a clay-fence post, a clay-sheep bites the top of the turnip helpfully and gets dragged forward when the turnip suddenly lurches downward

Smashing clay-ice-blocks in the village square to free the clay-postman frozen inside as the afternoon clay-sun softens the sculpture from the top down — the clay-tinkerer swings a clay-mallet and chunks of clay-ice scatter, the clay-baker chisels with a clay-butter-knife furiously, the clay-grandma pours a kettle of clay-steam over the surface, a clay-rabbit licks the ice block near the postman's clay-boot, and the postman himself visibly begins to tilt forward as the base melts faster than the top

Rolling a clay-barrel of glowing clay-fireflies up a steep cobblestone hill at midnight as they begin escaping through barrel-cracks and lighting the road — the clay-tinkerer pushes from behind with both boots braced, the clay-witch pulls a rope from the front leaning at forty-five degrees, a clay-villager sprints alongside slapping clay-patches over each crack as new ones appear, the clay-rabbit rides the barrel steering with its ears, and the hilltop clay-tower they are heading toward has its lights already going out one by one

Stealing the clay-golden-egg from under the sleeping clay-hen in the village market as the hen begins rolling over mid-sleep — the clay-detective slides his clay-hand underneath millimeter by millimeter, the clay-shopkeeper holds a clay-feather duster and fans the hen gently to keep her drowsy, the clay-baker stands by the door making an exaggerated innocent face at passing clay-villagers, the clay-hen's eye cracks open and her clay-foot twitches, and the egg begins to glow with a warm amber seam along its equator

Building a towering clay-signal-fire on the clifftop as a clay-storm front rolls in pressing the clay-sea flat and purple — the clay-tinkerer stacks clay-driftwood logs into a wobbling pyramid, the clay-witch ignites the base with a clay-torch and the fire immediately bends sideways in the wind, a clay-villager loops clay-rope around the whole structure trying to hold it together, the clay-grandma feeds the fire with her clay-recipe-book page by page looking philosophical, and offshore a clay-ship's lights are barely visible between rising clay-waves

Dragging the escaped clay-automaton back toward the workshop as it extends a new clay-arm it assembled from parts it pulled off a clay-fence — the clay-tinkerer grips its original left arm with both hands and leans back, the clay-detective has looped a clay-lasso around one leg and braces against a lamppost, a clay-villager pushes from behind getting tangled in the automaton's trailing clay-wire, the clay-shopkeeper hangs her clay-sign on it trying to slow it down, and the automaton serenely grows a third arm and begins reaching for a nearby clay-chimney

Sculpting a copy of the stolen clay-idol before dawn as a clay-villain's clay-ship approaches in the harbor visible through the workshop window — the clay-tinkerer's hands blur over the clay-mass shaping eye-sockets and carved symbols, the clay-detective paints gold-glaze onto finished sections with a tiny brush, the clay-grandma reads aloud from a clay-scroll squinting at the markings, a clay-cat knocks over the reference-drawing and the tinkerer keeps going from memory, and the approaching ship's lantern grows visibly larger in the window's clay-glass

Lifting the collapsed clay-clocktower section off the clay-mayor's clay-hat as the clocktower continues crumbling above them — the clay-baker and clay-villager heave a broken clay-archway aside, the clay-tinkerer crawls through the rubble with a clay-support-pole, the clay-grandma has already pulled the clay-mayor halfway clear and is dragging him by his clay-waistcoat, a clay-rabbit digs frantically at loose clay-rubble with its forepaws, and the clock-face above them separates from the wall and begins a slow diagonal descent

Sneaking through the eerie clay-hedge-maze at night carrying a clay-lantern that keeps almost going out in the wind — the clay-detective presses flat against a hedge-wall as clay-shadows shift, the clay-rabbit darts ahead and freezes at each corner ears swiveling, the clay-tinkerer bumps the lantern into a branch and spills liquid-clay-wax, a clay-villager at the rear keeps turning around convinced the clay-topiary-animals are in different positions than a moment ago, and they are

Chasing the clay-kite that has lifted the clay-postman's entire mailbag into the sky as clay-letters rain down on the village — the clay-postman runs below with both arms up making desperate grabs, the clay-baker leaps from his clay-bakery awning catching three letters and crumpling them, the clay-shopkeeper builds a hasty clay-ladder from display-shelving that sways alarmingly, the clay-grandma pins a passing letter to the ground with her clay-walking-stick, and the kite drags the bag higher toward a clay-stormcloud shaped exactly like an iron

Mixing the wrong clay-ingredients into the clay-fountain at the village center as the water begins turning gold and hardening into solid streaks — the clay-witch dumps a clay-satchel of powder in and stirs with a clay-stick furiously correcting her formula, the clay-tinkerer measures clay-fluid into the fountain with a clay-beaker while reading upside-down notes, the clay-baker's clay-dog laps the water and immediately sits with a solid gold tongue, two clay-villagers try to plug the fountain's pipe with clay-rags that immediately gild themselves stiff

Hauling the enormous clay-meteor fragment into the village workshop on a clay-cart whose wheels are visibly bending outward under the load — the clay-tinkerer steers from the front gripping the cart-tongue, the clay-detective and clay-baker push from behind their clay-boots skidding on cobblestones, the clay-grandma packs clay-stones under each wheel to prevent rolling back while they rest, the meteor fragment glows faintly orange at its cracked core, and through the crack something smooth and geometric and clearly unnatural is visible inside

Repairing the cracked clay-dam above the village as clay-water spouts from seventeen different points simultaneously — the clay-tinkerer slaps clay-handfuls over the largest jet and leans his whole body against it, the clay-baker passes clay-bricks from a wheelbarrow at a sprint, the clay-villager stuffs her clay-apron into a mid-height crack, the clay-grandma mixes a bucket of mortar-clay with a wooden spoon without spilling a drop despite the chaos, and behind the dam the clay-water-level visible through a measuring-post is two notches higher than when they started

Toppling the clay-statue of the village founder to reveal the clay-tunnel entrance beneath its pedestal before the clay-fog rolls fully over the harbor — the clay-detective wraps a clay-rope around the statue's waist, the clay-tinkerer builds a leverage-rig from clay-pipes and a cartwheel in forty seconds, the clay-baker and clay-villager heave on the rope together, the clay-rabbit is already digging around the pedestal base, the statue tips, pivots on one heel, and reveals a clay-trapdoor covered in stamped clay-symbols, and the fog is now at the first row of clay-houses

Stuffing the wildly multiplying clay-bread-rolls back into the clay-oven as they roll off every surface and begin stacking against the kitchen walls — the clay-baker scoops armloads off the floor and kicks the oven door open with his clay-boot, the clay-grandma blocks the kitchen door with her broad clay-back as rolls pile up behind her, the clay-shopkeeper stands on the clay-table trying to catch the ones bouncing off the ceiling, a clay-cat surfs a moving island of rolls across the floor with a completely satisfied expression, and the oven, already full, slowly opens its door again

Discovering the clay-mirror in the abandoned clay-manor reflects everyone in the room except for the clay-witch who cast the revealing-spell — the clay-detective presses his clay-nose to the mirror surface tracing an outline that should be there, the clay-tinkerer holds a clay-candle close and the flame-reflection behaves differently near the witch's position, the clay-grandma touches the mirror's clay-frame and her clay-fingers sink slightly into it, the clay-rabbit refuses to approach closer than two clay-floor-tiles away and digs its paws in, and the witch stands very still in a way that has begun to look like a choice rather than a coincidence

Wrestling the clay-weather-vane back into submission as it spins on its own in dead-still air and the clay-compass-needles in the workshop below all point at it — the clay-tinkerer grabs the vane's rooster-neck with both clay-hands and it slowly rotates him with it, the clay-detective wedges a clay-chock against the shaft while being gently spun sideways, the clay-baker sits on the roof-peak holding a guide-rope attached to the vane looking very uncertain about this plan, the clay-grandma passes tools up a clay-ladder with methodical calm, and the vane suddenly stops pointing due north-by-northwest directly at the fog-covered hill no-one has ever climbed

Hauling a collapsed seven-tier clay wedding cake back upright before the clay-bride arrives — the clay-baker shoves the bottom tier with his shoulder, his thumbprints smearing across the fondant clay, the clay-shopkeeper wedges a clay-broomstick under the tilting middle layers, the clay-grandma slaps extra clay putty onto the crumbling seams with both palms, the clay-postman's bicycle leans against the doorframe as he passes up clay flowers tier by tier, sugar-pearl clay beads bouncing across the cobblestone floor

Chasing the runaway clay pig through the bakery as it skids across the floury clay counter — the clay-baker grabs for its curling tail and misses, smashing his elbow into a rack of cooling clay loaves, the clay-grandma blocks the doorway with a clay mixing bowl held wide, the clay-shopkeeper dives under the table grabbing at trotters, the pig launches off the windowsill trailing a streamer of raw clay dough across the ceiling

Discovering a sealed clay door behind the bakery fireplace that breathes cold air and hums — the clay-detective traces the carved symbols around its frame with a magnifying clay-lens, the clay-baker presses his ear flat against the surface his painted iris bulging wide, the clay-grandma backs away crossing her clay arms firmly, the clay-tinkerer chips at the mortar with a tiny clay chisel, a clay-candle on the mantle blows out in the draft without anyone touching it

Toppling an entire display pyramid of clay jam-jars in the village shop during an argument over the last clay-marmalade — the clay-shopkeeper lunges across the counter arms windmilling, the clay-grandma refuses to release her grip on the jar as everything cascades, the clay-postman ducks under the wave of sticky clay spheres rolling off the shelves, the clay-villager at the door slips on a jar and slides into a barrel of clay pickles, orange clay-marmalade splashes coat every visible surface

Mixing a bubbling clay-cauldron that begins rattling across the floor on its own clay legs — the clay-witch grabs the handle with both oven-mitted hands trying to stop its march, the clay-tinkerer jams a clay wedge under one foot to no effect, the clay-detective circles it with a notebook scribbling furiously, the clay-rabbit darts between everyone's legs in a panic knocking over three jars of clay spell-dust, the cauldron tips forward belching a geyser of luminous green clay-foam across the ceiling

Repairing the clay-village clock tower as its giant clay-gear teeth begin raining down one by one onto the square — the clay-tinkerer hangs from a rope bolting a clay-gear back with a wrench, the clay-postman shields his clay-head with his mail-bag as a tooth bounces off the cobbles, the clay-baker pushes his bread-cart away at a run, the clay-detective sketches the mechanism from behind a barrel, the final gear the size of a cartwheel leans off its axle threatening to take the whole tower face with it

Stuffing an enormous clay turkey into an undersized clay oven while the holiday guests are already knocking — the clay-baker sits on the oven door with his full weight, his clay knees up by his ears, the clay-grandma pushes the turkey's drumstick in with a rolling pin, the clay-shopkeeper reads the recipe aloud with increasing alarm, the clay-postman braces the oven legs against the floor with his boots as the whole appliance slides back across the flagstones, clay-grease splattering up the walls in amber arcs

Sliding a clay-toboggan loaded with the clay-baker's entire bread order down an icy clay hillside out of control — the clay-baker rides on top arms flailing, his clay-hat spiraling away into the distance, the clay-grandma at the bottom throws up a clay-net to catch it which immediately tears, the clay-tinkerer runs alongside trying to jam a clay-brake-lever while his scarf unravels behind him, the clay-postman's delivery cart is directly in the path and he scrambles up a clay lamppost to avoid the collision

Smashing through the clay-village market stalls as a possessed clay-wheelbarrow accelerates downhill entirely on its own — the clay-tinkerer chases it with a remote-control device firing sparks, the clay-shopkeeper scoops her clay-fruit display off the table moments before impact, the clay-baker gets one handle and spins in three full circles before letting go, clay-cabbages exploding outward like green cannon-fire, the clay-detective plants himself in the path with a clay-lasso that immediately snaps on contact

Wrestling the enormous clay-turnip free from the earth at the village fair as a crowd urges them on — the clay-grandma has both arms wrapped around it leaning back at a forty-five degree angle, the clay-baker pushes from the side with his boot braced against a fencepost, the clay-sheep butts its clay head against it from the opposite side, the clay-villager grabs the grandma around the waist in a chain, the turnip makes a sucking clay-pop and launches them all backward like a cork from a bottle

Sculpting a clay-key from memory in near darkness inside the locked clay-tower before the tide-clay fills the floor — the clay-tinkerer's fingers work by feel alone shaping the clay-blank, the clay-detective holds a tiny clay-match stub casting wobbling light, the clay-rabbit gnaws at the wooden door-frame in parallel excavation, water-clay seeping in under the door with visible rippling texture, the clay-tinkerer holds the finished key up against the lock and in the match-light it is almost but not quite the right shape

Lifting a crashed clay-airship out of the village fountain before it blocks the water supply entirely — the clay-tinkerer ties clay-ropes around the balloon envelope and cranks a winch, the clay-baker and clay-postman haul together on the same line their clay-boots slipping on the wet cobbles, the clay-detective leans into the cockpit extracting a crumpled clay-map before the vessel rises, the clay-grandma directs everything from the fountain rim with a clay-umbrella as a conductor's baton, the airship groans and one clay-propeller detaches and sails into a chimney

Stealing the clay-detective's evidence-board in broad daylight while disguised as a clay-lamppost — the clay-villain tips out of lamppost posture and grabs the board, the clay-detective spins from his desk to find it gone, the clay-rabbit saw everything and tugs urgently at the detective's coat, the clay-tinkerer spots the fleeing lamppost-shaped figure from the rooftop and gives chase along clay-gutters, the clay-grandma trips the lamppost with her walking stick as it rounds the corner sending clay-evidence-pins scattering like confetti

Rolling the giant runaway clay-cheese wheel through the village as it flattens every clay-fence post in its path — the clay-baker sprints alongside trying to steer it with his bread-paddle, the clay-shopkeeper stacks clay-crates as a barrier that detonate spectacularly, the clay-grandma mounts the cheese like a rodeo and rides it steering with her umbrella, the clay-detective films the trajectory for evidence, the cheese clips the church wall and launches skyward for one glorious impossible moment before landing in the clay-pond with a tremendous flat splash

Dragging the ancient clay-chest up from the village cellar as its carved surface pulses with faint orange light — the clay-detective and clay-tinkerer haul on the rope together, their armature-wire fingers straining, the clay-grandma sweeps cobwebs off its lid with her shawl backing away quickly, the clay-shopkeeper holds the trapdoor open with visible reluctance, the chest scrapes up through the opening and its latch trembles as though something inside is pressing outward, nobody is quite close enough to be the one to open it

Building a clay-rocket in the village square overnight before the clay-mayor can ban the project at dawn — the clay-tinkerer spot-welds clay-panels with a tiny torch, the clay-baker mixes fuel-clay in a massive bowl his apron dripping, the clay-rabbit ferries clay-rivets in a mouth-load at a time, the clay-postman reads the instruction-scroll upside down then right-way up with equal confusion, the clay-detective stands watch with a clock timing the gap before sunrise as the rocket grows five stories tall and worryingly lopsided

Sneaking the forbidden clay-recipe book out of the witch's library while she debates ingredients with her clay-crows — the clay-tinkerer tiptoes along the shelf using clay-suction-cups on his palms, the clay-detective maps the floor-creak positions from the doorway pointing a silent route, the clay-rabbit diverts the crows by rolling a clay-acorn along the far shelf, a clay-bookcase slowly begins tipping toward the tinkerer as he shifts weight pulling the book free, the crow nearest him opens one painted glass eye wider than the other

Mixing the wrong clay-potions together as the witch's shop shelves begin dissolving starting from the top — the clay-witch shoves both cork-stoppers back in simultaneously with her elbows, the clay-shopkeeper grabs bottles at random and moves them to safety, the clay-grandma fans the fumes away with her hat her hair rising straight up, the clay-tinkerer builds a containment wall of clay-bricks around the spill in real time, the ceiling develops a slow drip of luminous purple clay that lands on the cat who turns briefly and magnificently into a frog

Repairing the village clay-bridge as a clay-cart loaded with clay-barrels approaches from the far bank — the clay-tinkerer hammers clay-planks down at speed, the clay-baker passes planks up the chain on the bank, the clay-postman waves his arms at the approaching cart-driver who waves cheerfully back not slowing, the clay-sheep on the bridge refuses to move and has to be carried one clay-hoof at a time, the first wheel rolls onto the repaired section as the last nail goes in and the whole bridge sags theatrically but holds

Toppling the clay-witch's enchanted scarecrow from the village field before it reaches the first cottage — the clay-detective lassoes one arm from a safe distance and the rope stretches but holds, the clay-tinkerer aims a device that fires hardening-clay foam coating the scarecrow's legs, the clay-grandma stands absolutely still insisting it cannot see things that do not move while it turns its stitched clay-head directly toward her, the clay-baker throws his heaviest bread-tray as a discus that clips its hat off revealing a clay-gear mechanism underneath

Hauling the escaped clay-octopus back toward its tank at the village fair science exhibit — the clay-tinkerer grabs two tentacles and leans back with his full weight, the clay-postman has one tentacle wrapped around his waist being dragged forward, the clay-detective slips a clay-bucket over the main body groping blind, the clay-baker's entire cake display table gets a tentacle under it and levitates impressively, the clay-grandma alone carries on eating her clay-candyfloss with serene patience as chaos orbits her in all directions

Discovering the clay-village has been slowly sinking into the clay-ground as the cobblestones now sit at knee height — the clay-detective measures with a ruler and updates a worrying chalk line on the wall, the clay-tinkerer assembles a clay-jack-screw device to lift the entire bakery, the clay-grandma's doorstep has vanished entirely so she steps straight from the ground into her kitchen, the clay-postman delivers letters through what used to be the first-floor window now at ground level, the clay-baker shovels clay from his cellar which immediately refills

Chasing the clay-map across the rooftops as the wind carries it chimney to chimney through the clay-village night — the clay-detective leaps between clay-tiles his coat streaming, the clay-rabbit bounds three steps ahead always one gust too slow to snatch it, the clay-tinkerer fires a suction-cup arrow from the street below that sticks to a gargoyle instead, the clay-grandma opens her attic window and almost catches it in her clay-laundry basket before another gust snatches it higher, the map spirals against the full moon and reveals its markings only when backlit

Smashing the frozen clay-pipe in the bakery basement with everything available before the whole building ices from within — the clay-baker swings a clay-mallet against the frost-coated pipe, ice-clay exploding in geometric shards, the clay-tinkerer wraps the pipe in heated clay-tape unspooling furiously, the clay-grandma pours steaming clay-broth along the floor toward the source, the clay-sheep headbutts a secondary valve open by accident which causes a second pipe to geyser boiling steam, and the first pipe finally cracks releasing a flood of glittering clay-water across the whole floor

Dragging the enormous clay-meteor fragment through the village gate after it landed in the turnip field at midnight — the clay-tinkerer straps it to a clay-cart and pulls the harness, the clay-detective scrapes a sample off its surface into a clay-vial, the clay-villager pushes from the back slipping on clay-mud every third step, the clay-grandma circles it with a candle squinting at the markings scored across its surface that look almost but not quite like letters, the fragment pulses with internal warmth and the clay-cart wheels begin softening at the contact points

Hauling a runaway clay-wedding-cake on a tilting clay-trolley down the cobblestone hill as it leans further with every bump — the clay-baker sprints alongside jamming her thumbs into the frosting tier trying to straighten it, the clay-postman abandons his clay-letterbox and throws himself under the trolley's wheel as a brake, the clay-grandma leans from her clay-windowsill swinging a clay-ladle to hook the top tier, a clay-villager dives sideways as the bottom layer sheds clay-roses across the lane

Discovering a sealed clay-trapdoor beneath the clay-shop floorboards that pulses with faint amber light — the clay-detective pries at the edges with a clay-crowbar, the clay-shopkeeper yanks bolts off with shaking fingers, a clay-rabbit presses its ear flat to the wood listening, the clay-grandma holds a clay-lantern overhead casting warped shadows on the clay-cellar walls, the floor around the trapdoor cracks in radiating lines releasing wisps of orange clay-smoke

Chasing a misfired clay-rocket that skips and bounces through the clay-village market trailing sparks of red-clay fire — the clay-tinkerer scrambles after it waving a clay-net, the clay-baker shoves her clay-bread display into the street as a barricade, two clay-shopkeepers flip their clay-awning down to try to catch it, the clay-postman pedals his clay-bicycle backward in panicked retreat, a clay-sheep bolts into the fountain scattering clay-coins everywhere

Stuffing a mountain of wriggling clay-fish back into a cracked clay-barrel before the clay-inspector arrives at the door — the clay-shopkeeper scoops armfuls with both hands, a clay-villager sits on the lid while fish push the lid off his lap, the clay-baker binds the barrel with clay-twine using her teeth, the clay-rabbit wedges its whole body into the gap as temporary seal, the clay-inspector's clay-shadow already stretches through the frosted clay-glass pane of the door

Rolling a colossal clay-snowball down the workshop slope that has swallowed the clay-tinkerer's favourite clay-wrench and three clay-gear-wheels — the clay-tinkerer runs alongside punching the surface trying to feel the wrench, a clay-sheep pushes from behind grunting with its head down, the clay-grandma steers with a clay-broom from the front trying to guide it around a clay-lamppost, the snowball clips the post anyway and the post bends sideways like a rubbery noodle

Sculpting a replacement clay-head for the clay-mayor's statue overnight before dawn reveals the original smashed in pieces on the clay-plaza — the clay-tinkerer shapes the nose with a knitting needle, the clay-baker smooths the chin with her thumb leaving a clear print, a clay-villager holds the clay-head steady on a wobbly clay-pole, the clay-detective sweeps clay-fragments into a pouch cataloguing every shard, the clay-grandma paints glossy enamel irises onto the unfinished face by clay-candlelight

Toppling a tower of clay-jam-jars in the clay-pantry while trying to retrieve one jar that has grown legs and is actively climbing higher — the clay-baker snatches jars as they fall and stacks them on her head, the clay-grandma swings from a clay-shelf bracket reaching for the walking jar, a clay-rabbit catches falling jars in its apron, the clay-shopkeeper shoves a clay-stepladder across the floor as the jar nears the ceiling and the whole pantry structure groans

Sliding a replacement clay-turkey onto the clay-banquet-table through the kitchen hatch seconds before the guests enter the hall — the clay-baker greases the hatch and shoves it through, the clay-grandma in the hall clicks the hatch closed with one elbow while arranging clay-gravy-boats with the other, the clay-shopkeeper in a borrowed clay-waiter's-coat kicks clay-feathers under the tablecloth, the turkey slides perfectly into place then slowly, inevitably, rotates ninety degrees and falls off the clay-platter with a tremendous splat
